data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'doron' meaning 'gift'. The name Donni symbolizes the gift of life or a beloved child in the Christian faith. The name Donni carries the meaning “My People” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Donni usually hope their child will grow to embody my people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's grace and blessings.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Donni total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
